core/utils/media/manifest.ts

Runtime knowledge of which CDN objects exist, backed by the
Sourcesrc/core/utils/media/manifest.ts
UX surfaceShared primitives every surface builds on — no direct UI.

Members

keys

Parsed bucket key set — null until (or unless) the manifest fetch lands.

pending

In-flight fetch dedupe — multiple boot callers share one request.

initMediaManifest

Fetches the bucket key manifest once; resolves immediately on repeat calls. Fire-and-forget at boot — renders that happen before it lands simply emit no , which is the safe path.

mediaManifestReady

Whether the manifest has arrived. Lets the media-figure probe distinguish "unknown — try webp" from "known-absent — skip straight to the original".

mediaKeyExists

Whether the manifest lists the CDN object behind url. Absolute URLs get the CDN_BASE prefix stripped to their bucket key; non-CDN URLs (gravatars, data URIs) always report false — they have no siblings.

  • @param url Full media URL or a raw bucket key.

webpIfExists

webp sibling of a .jpg URL when the manifest confirms it was generated, '' otherwise — safe srcset input for a : empty means "no source".

  • @param url Original .jpg media URL.

webmIfExists

webm sibling of an .mp4 URL when it exists in the manifest, '' otherwise. <video><source> DOES retry the next source on network failure, so this gate is belt-and-suspenders for saving a doomed request, not correctness.

  • @param url Original .mp4 media URL.

(module scope)

Manifest-gated cover URL matrix — see coverVariants().

src

URL for — full-res mozjpeg when proven, else the original.

webp

webp matching src, '' when not proven.

mobileJpg

≤768px jpg for a media-scoped , '' when not proven.

mobileWebp

≤768px webp — preferred over mobileJpg when both exist.

coverVariants

Resolves the responsive cover matrix for one covers/<stem>.jpg URL: the mozjpeg full-res derivative (same pixels, ~70% fewer bytes) plus its 768px mobile tier and webp siblings — each gated on mediaKeyExists so an unproven object can never become the card's only image. A missing/never-loaded manifest yields the original URL with its own webp probe — exactly today's behavior.

  • @param coverJpg Emission-encoded covers/*.jpg URL (original).
  • @returns Bound URLs for picture/img — empty strings mean "omit".
